title: Waste of money
text: This subscription is junk! It's almost like they went to the $ Tree and bought items to fill the box. The mom items were a joke and the dog items lasted a whole 5 minutes with my dog. I should've done more research before purchasing. Not to mention it took and entire month to receive my first box and I was charged for my second box before I even got my first one! Just don't do it.
label: negative
